name: VPD Cadet Program
org: Vancouver Police Department, funded by the Vancouver Police Foundation
what_you_do: A free 28-week leadership program. Cadets learn teamwork, public speaking and fitness, do community service and drill, march in parades, go camping, and see how police units like the Marine and Canine Units work.
who_can_apply: Teens going into Grade 10, 11 or 12 who live in or go to school in Vancouver. You must want to graduate and not miss a lot of school, and have no serious arrests or convictions, no record of repeated negative contact with police, and no gang ties.
pay_detail: Free. The Vancouver Police Foundation pays for all program materials and fees.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for the 2026/2027 school year. The VPD page says to check back in the spring. Last pattern: the call for the class starting September 2025 was posted April 25, 2025.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the Apply Now button on the VPD Cadet page when it reopens in spring 2027. Questions: cadets@vpd.ca.
notes: About 90 cadets a year. It is a leadership program, not police recruiting. The VPD Indigenous Cadet Program is a different summer job for ages 19 to 29. Unpaid, so BC child employment rules for paid work do not apply here.
